about: World 1 acceptance bands: the rows the Gate reads for a finished Spillway (dam, flume, Brindle). scripts/world1-bands.mjs evaluates them. status gate: a miss or a missing input fails the read. status report: measured and printed but never fails, until the units in enforced_from land and the coordinator flips it to gate. status info: shown, no threshold. status sitting: a thing only Andrew can judge at his sitting, listed and never graded. With --sitting the rows are the whole definition of world 1 done (ruling dt): every one of the 11 areas has gate rows and one sitting row, a source receipt row reads the JSON receipt of a check this reader cannot run and names the command that writes it (producer), and a receipt row with a plant passes only when its receipt says that planted fault was caught on the head being judged. Run length lives in the pacing file (source pacing) and the panel band in #398's drop sim; neither is restated here. Thresholds are the integrator ledger's (/mnt/project-files/world1/BUDGETS.md); change a number there first.

bots.measure: the pacing file's measure block (table, stages, seeds, pilots, bot_args, policy_args) is the run recipe; the completionist explores until done with --explore-by=900 as a safety clock (ruling ag)

rows.targets_note: 15 Nov 2026, ruling dt: the w1 and w2 Novice and Learner attempt 5 bands are ruling cu's targets (dam Novice at most 20%, flume Novice at most 15%, Learner attempt 5 between 30% and 60%), which replace the w1 Novice <= 42% re-pin and the >= 60% Learner attempt 5 reading below; the last measured w1 Novice is 35% (wave 37 read, 12 Nov), so this row misses until the difficulty work lands. History: Recorded bands (coordinator ruling ab, DECISIONS section 5, 26 Oct 20:58Z row, PR #504): w1 Novice <= 40% (two seeds of margin over the measured 33% at 24 seeds) at dam mob hits x1.5 (33%, 24 seeds, receipt /mnt/project-files/world1/bands-w19/); park1 and park2 Novice reach stays at the measured 100%: re-read after the pacing lock rows landed (24 seeds a band on d30a2965, library learner-0e2bc2f0, receipt /mnt/project-files/world1/bands-w20/park-reach-d30a2965/), Novice 100% [86%-100%] and Learner a1 100% on both parks. The yard lock and the Warden clamp sit on the way to the Warden or in its fight, and a parkN cell wins when the Warden is engaged, so neither moves reach; a cell that grades the park clear would see them. w1 Learner a5 grades against the >= 60% harness target again (9 Nov, wave 33, DECISIONS section 10): ruling bb's wave 29 waiver (>= 58%) is retired, measured 83% (20/24) on w31 and w32, receipt /mnt/project-files/gate/w32-58a6de62/bands-B.md. w1 Novice <= 42% for w31 (coordinator, ruling ab re-pin, DECISIONS row bk, 8 Nov): measured 42% (10/24) on stage/alpha-w31 1013c7d1 and 0786c1a8, every run identical; #619's reseed plus rulings bf and bg make every band stronger (overpowered pays); re-read after the sitting; provisional until the bands B rerun on the ruling bl head (the bot's point-blank bite cadence), which decides the number. Every other cell and column grades against scripts/challenge/lib.mjs TARGETS.
